calls.title: GrowthBook Developer Training Session
calls.summary: The team discussed a strategy to implement data-driven experimentation to make more informed product decisions and prevent ineffective feature rollouts. Chris Sanders highlighted that only a third of deployed features improve products, underscoring a shift from test-driven development to experimentation-driven development, which promotes launching MVPs and iterating based on results. The technical setup for integrating GrowthBook with data systems, particularly Snowflake, was detailed, covering aspects like SDK event tracking and experiment assignment queries. The importance of establishing robust governance through approval flows and audit history was emphasized to avoid unauthorized changes. Additionally, advanced methodologies like Cupid and post stratification were presented to enhance the accuracy of experimental results and reporting.
calls.keywords: Feature Flags, Experimentation, Snowflake, SDK Integration, Data Warehouse, Metrics Reporting
calls.action_items:

Continue implementing the common SDK module and API for feature flags and experimentation to standardize development workflow (25:04)

**Chris Sanders**

**Team Developers**
